app_description: Free robotics and STEM lessons for learners, teachers and parents. Build robots from cardboard, then learn to code them.
home_intro: Build a real robot from cardboard, sticks and one small motor. Then learn to control it with code.
home_point_offline: Works on basic phones, even offline
about_mission: Robots For All makes robotics and STEM education free for every child and adult, whatever their income, language or school.
about_how_build: Build: make moving robots from cardboard using cranks, gears, levers and linkages, linked to the school syllabus.
about_how_control: Control: add a micro:bit or similar board to make your robot move, stop and light up.
about_how_integrate: Integrate: design complete robot projects that combine everything you have learned.
about_who_body: Learners from Grade 3 upward, teachers, robotics coaches, parents, homeschool families, schools and community centres.
privacy_intro: Robots For All is used by children, so we collect as little as possible. Here is exactly what happens when you use this site.
privacy_collect_none: Nothing about you. There are no accounts, no sign-up forms and no cookies.
privacy_collect_no_tracking: No ads, no tracking and no analytics. We don't load anything from other websites.
privacy_collect_hosting: Our hosting provider (Cloudflare) delivers the pages and may keep basic technical records, such as IP addresses, for a short time to keep the site safe. We don't use these records to identify anyone.
privacy_device_title: What is saved on your phone
privacy_device_body: To work without internet, this site saves its pages, and any lessons you download, in your browser's storage on your own phone. This never leaves your phone.
privacy_device_remove: To remove it, clear this site's data in your browser settings.
privacy_children_body: Children can use every lesson without giving any personal information. If we add accounts later, a parent, guardian or teacher will set them up, and we will update this page first.
privacy_changes_body: If anything here changes, we will update this page before the change happens.
lessons_intro: Hands-on robotics lessons using cheap and recycled materials. Each lesson follows five steps: Predict, Run, Investigate, Modify and Make. Junior lessons, for Grades R to 2, have four: Predict, Run, Try and Make.

lesson_adult_help: An adult must help with some steps.

enrol_notice_title: What we keep about your child, and why
enrol_notice_kept: We keep only a nickname, the grade, a picture they choose, their language, their lesson records and their badges.
enrol_notice_not_kept: We never keep your child’s photo, ID number, birth date, address or phone number, and nothing about them is sent to any AI.
enrol_notice_who: Only you, and the teachers or coaches of the classes you choose, can see your child’s records. Nobody can message your child.
enrol_notice_why: So your child can record their learning, earn badges and certificates, and their teacher can see their progress.
enrol_notice_withdraw: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time in your account. Withdrawing deletes your child’s records.

enrol_nickname_hint: A first name with an initial (for example Thandi R) or a fun name. Not their full name.

Hello,

{organisation} has asked to enrol your child in the class {class} on Robots For All, a free robotics and coding learning site.

Nothing is recorded until you agree. To read what is kept, choose your child’s nickname and give your consent, open this link within 14 days:

{link}

Sign in with this email address when asked. If you do nothing, the request and your email address are deleted after 14 days.

If you don’t know this school or club, ignore this email.

Robots For All

account_enrol_waiting: Waiting for a parent to confirm

confirm_other_email: This link was sent to a different email address. Sign in with the email address the school or club used.
confirm_sign_in_first: Sign in with the email address this link was sent to. We send you a code; no password is needed.
confirm_asked: asked to enrol your child in
confirm_keep_name: Keep the name the school or club typed, for my child’s certificates and badges (stored locked; their class’s teachers can see it). You can change or remove it later.
email_enrol_reminder_subject: Reminder: please confirm your child’s enrolment with Robots For All
email_dormant_subject: Your Robots For All account will be deleted unless you sign in

Hello,

Nobody has signed in to your Robots For All account for {months} months. We keep data only while it is needed, so the account will be deleted after 12 months without a sign-in, with any child’s profile that is not in a class.

To keep it, just sign in: {link}

Before then you can also save a copy of your child’s records from Your account.

Robots For All

helper_status_blocked: That answer wasn't safe to show. Use only the battery pack from the parts list, and ask an adult before using tools.

children_helper_about: your child can type a question about the lesson they're on, like "why won't my rhino's jaw close?", and get a short answer. It only helps with science, technology, engineering and maths, and safety always comes first. Your child can ask up to 5 questions a day, only on lesson pages. Their teacher can also switch it off for the class.
children_helper_sent: no personal information is shared. We never send your child's name, nickname, school or account. If you or your child type a name, phone number, email address or home address into a question, the helper takes it out before the question is sent. It can miss some, so please don't type them. What goes is the question, the lesson and your child's grade band (for example Grade 3–4). The answer comes from an AI company's computers outside South Africa.
children_helper_kept: only how many questions your child asked each day, for 31 days. We don't store the questions or answers, so nobody can read them later.
children_helper_consent: I'm this child's parent or guardian, I've read this, and I allow my child to ask the AI helper.
children_helper_turned_on: The AI helper is on for your child.
children_helper_turned_off: The AI helper is off for your child.
progress_helper_allowed: Learners may ask the AI helper
progress_helper_about: Only learners whose parent turned the helper on can ask, on lesson pages. You see how many questions were asked, never what.
children_helper_wrong: every answer says so, and tells your child to ask an adult before using tools, cutting or heat.
children_helper_safety: if your child writes something that sounds like they're hurt, scared or unsafe, the helper tells them to speak to a trusted adult and that Childline is free on 116. Because nothing is stored, nobody else is told, so please keep talking with your child about who they can go to.
children_helper_charge: you can turn the helper off here at any time, and it stops straight away.
